cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I hid the first complaint letter. What happened to the second? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. I'm not asking you to stand in the spotlight alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's put our envelopes down in order.

mechanism: A manages complaint disclosure by revealing personal concealment in stages and offering shared exposure so B will identify the other hidden letters.
confusable: An ordinary investigation does not put A own confession beside B missing one as a reciprocal invitation.
comparison: Meeting alternative reconstructs logistical errors; this one assembles concealed written complaints with escalating shared risk.
seedUse: Letter seed supplies first/second/third sequence; S02 needs practical shared attribution rather than a spotlight metaphor.
